acceptance_effect: Blocks W03/W34 receiving until fixed and rerun at exact 100k.
evidence: PYAT_W03_W04_MCR_C_Commission.md:45 (negative: compressed retained-body size falls while cold I02 peak remains unchanged or rises)
impact: The W03 aggregate can move because of W04 cache-body/persist memory while the W03 I02-to-first-I03 peak is unchanged. This is the explicitly forbidden RED direction and makes the W03/W34 pair uninterpretable.
minimal_owner_action: Make --scenario cold a no-persist cold build or capture and use a pre-persist peak through first I03/I05; keep persistence in full-matrix/separate stage and report both peaks; add a test that cold does not call ParquetC11Carrier.persist (or that W03 uses only the pre-persist peak), and that a compact-only change with unchanged pre-persist peak cannot pass.
observed: In the snapshotted bench draft, _worker persists whenever worker_scenario is cold or full-matrix and a root is supplied (bench_w03_w04_physical.py:519-525); _run_scenario always supplies a root and passes worker_scenario='cold' for the cold scenario (:638-653); the aggregate used for the W03 threshold is metrics.rss_peak_bytes (:534-540), aggregated at :597-618 and compared at :622-635. The 16-row candidate cold run reports aggregate 103,653,376 B, persist peak 103,653,376 B / delta 38,850,560 B, compact 64,471,040 B, i02_validation_seal 42,455,040 B / delta 0, firstconsumer 64,802,816 B. The protected 4f3413fc 16-row cold run reports aggregate 104,046,592 B, compact 99,053,568 B, firstconsumer 99,500,032 B, persist peak 104,046,592 B / delta 4,546,560 B. The candidate compact stage is much lower but the aggregate is essentially unchanged because persist dominates.
title: W03 cold scenario includes W04 Parquet persist, so the reported cold peak is contaminated by cache write memory

acceptance_effect: Blocks W03 receiving until stage peaks are real.
evidence: PYAT_W03_W04_MCR_C_Commission.md:45 (instrument stage peaks rather than only compressed retained bodies)
PYAT_W03_W04_MCR_C_Commission.md:77-78 (stage peaks; process peak from cold start)
impact: The evidence cannot attribute cold high-water to projection, object construction, canonical hashing, I02 validation/seal, compact or first consumer; a compact/persist memory shift can mask a cold I02 regression. The W03 stage-allocation requirement is not met.
minimal_owner_action: Record stage entry/exit current RSS and a true per-stage peak (sampling or isolated child); keep process_ru_maxrss separate; measure actual projection or label it combined with profile setup; add a regression test where a post-high-water allocation changes only the stage peak.
observed: _stage records ru_maxrss after the stage and max(0, after_peak-before_peak) (bench_w03_w04_physical.py:84-98). Once a previous stage raises the process high-water, later stages report delta 0 even if they allocate. _build_release labels projection as built before the stage and then records a post-hoc high-water (:332-371); objectconstruction and canonicalhash share wall only and have no RSS; i02validation/seal duplicate one stage; firstconsumer is another cumulative high-water (:422-423). Bounded candidate cold 16 shows i02_validation_seal delta 0, firstconsumer delta 307,200, and no RSS for object construction/canonical hash. Bounded 24-row full-matrix cold shows i02_validation_seal delta 0 and firstconsumer delta 335,872.
title: Stage RSS is cumulative process high-water, not a stage peak; projection/object/hash are not actually measured

acceptance_effect: Blocks any 100k acceptance claim until the cap is effective and recorded.
evidence: PYAT_W03_W04_MCR_C_Commission.md:78 (if 100000 events exhaust authorized memory, mark exact BLOCKED_EXACT_DEPENDENCY; never downsize and declare full pass)
impact: The scale-safety and BLOCKED semantics are not established; a large profile or wide/repeat run can be killed before the cap can produce an exact blocked result. cap_enforced=false contradicts the claimed 6 GiB protection.
minimal_owner_action: Set the limit before profile/cell construction, ideally in a small launcher before bench imports/data construction; record enforcement as a precondition of every run; if the platform cannot enforce it, emit BLOCKED_EXACT_DEPENDENCY; add a low-cap over-limit test.
observed: _worker calls _profile(profile, rows) before the resource.setrlimit(RLIMIT_AS, MAX_CHILD_BYTES) attempt (bench_w03_w04_physical.py:438-461; MAX_CHILD_BYTES at :49). The 100k respondents, row bindings and routing are constructed before the cap, and profile_setup is recorded before cap_enforced becomes true. The author partial 100k narrow proof_02_resource_comparison.json records cap_enforced false for both current 46b and protected 4f3413fc, while the return/02 text says a 6 GiB child cap is used. The author 100k peak is 5,923,426,304 B; it completed under 6 GiB but the cap was not enforced.
title: 6 GiB cap is installed after profile/cell construction, and the author 100k receipt reports cap_enforced false

acceptance_effect: Blocks W03/W34 receiving; final same-HQ-SHA 100k 3-repeat receipt required.

impact: The W03 cold baseline cannot currently be paired at all; even if it could, the benchmark would report observations rather than an auditable pass/fail; an arbitrary baseline or a single-run matrix could be mistaken for acceptance. The author's 100k narrow partial is a regression, not a pass.
minimal_owner_action: Fix the cold-only lookup; bind the baseline to protected 4f3413fc, same rows/profiles/repetitions/host, exact command and output hash; compare stage and aggregate values; hard-fail nonzero on NO_BASELINE/mismatch/unmet 15% RSS, >10% RSS regression, or >90% warm restart wall; add explicit retention; test cold-only baseline, no baseline, wrong rows/host, and threshold failure.
observed: The W03 check is --scenario cold (commission:45). A cold-only baseline has warm:null. _run_scenario evaluates (baseline_for or {}).get('warm', {}).get('aggregate') at bench_w03_w04_physical.py:684; when warm is present but null this dereferences None and raises AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'get'. Separately, --baseline-json accepts arbitrary JSON (:725-727), _compare only reports ratios/status (:622-635), regressions only emits wall >10% (:685-691), and there is no >=15% RSS pass, <=90% warm restart wall pass, >10% RSS regression check, or conditional retention. The author's 1000-row matrix used one process per section, not three process-isolated repeats; the 100k narrow ratio is reported by the author as 1.1303 (+13.0% RSS versus protected), target >=15% improvement not met.
title: Cold-only baseline pairing crashes; baseline identity and the 15%/90%/10%-RSS/retention gates are not enforced

acceptance_effect: W34 repeat/retention evidence is incomplete; no whole W34 acceptance.
evidence: PYAT_W03_W04_MCR_C_Commission.md:53 (end-to-end CPU wall RSS disk files source-open counts and benefit-aware retention)
PYAT_W03_W04_MCR_C_Commission.md:78 (source opens, restore cost, write amortization)
impact: The W34 repeat-heavy restart/first-consumer <=90% claim and the benefit-aware retention decision cannot be substantiated by the current harness; the amortization is a divide-by-repeat-count estimate, not measured reuse.
minimal_owner_action: Instrument actual source opens or emit explicit NOT_APPLICABLE__SOURCEFREE_SYNTHETIC_STREAM; count cache reads/writes and run at least two fresh-process warm restarts from the same persisted cache; compute amortization from actual uses/bytes; add a nonbeneficial persist case and an explicit retention decision with a test.
observed: source_opens is hard-coded to 0 at bench_w03_w04_physical.py:540. For the sourcefree ExactPhysicalCellStream zero opens may be a legitimate N/A, but it is not measured and is not labelled N/A. cache_write_amortization is only persist.wall_seconds / profile['repeat_count'] (:541-544). The repeat profile repeats _consumer on the same release in the same child process (:424-427); it does not perform repeated fresh-process warm restarts from one persisted cache. No nonbeneficial persist case or explicit conditional-retention decision is implemented.
title: Source-open and repeat/retention economics are asserted rather than measured
